title: Activate my card
text: To activate your new card, open the mobile banking app and go to the "Cards" section. Select the card you want to activate and tap "Activate Card." Follow the on-screen instructions, which may include entering the last four digits of your card and your PIN. Activation is usually instant, allowing you to use your card immediately. If you experience any issues, please contact customer support through the app for assistance.

title: Age limit
text: Our mobile banking app is available to users aged 13 and older. Teens between 13 and 17 can open a youth account with parental or guardian consent. To set up an account for a minor, the parent or guardian must provide identification and complete the consent form during registration. Once approved, the account is active immediately. Users 18 and older can open a standard account independently. If you have questions about youth accounts, please contact our support team for assistance.

title: Apple pay or google pay
text: You can top up your account using Apple Pay or Google Pay for quick and secure payments. To top up with Google Pay, open the app, select “Add Funds,” choose Google Pay as your payment method, and confirm the amount. For Apple Pay, open the app on your iPhone or Apple Watch, go to “Add Funds,” select Apple Pay, and complete the transaction. If your top-up does not go through, ensure your payment details are up to date and your device is connected to the internet. Transactions usually process instantly but may take up to 5 minutes. If issues persist, contact support.

title: Atm support
text: You can withdraw money from any ATM that displays the Visa or Mastercard logo, depending on your card type. Our app also provides a locator feature to find nearby ATMs that support fee-free withdrawals. To use your card at an ATM, simply insert or tap your card, enter your PIN, and select the withdrawal amount. Withdrawals are processed instantly, and you can access cash 24/7 at supported locations nationwide. Some ATMs may charge fees; check the app for fee-free options.

title: Automatic top up
text: Our app offers an automatic top-up feature to keep your balance above a set amount. To enable it, go to Settings, select Automatic Top-Up, and choose your preferred minimum balance and top-up amount. Once activated, the app will automatically add funds from your linked bank account when your balance falls below the minimum. Top-ups usually process instantly, but may take up to 5 minutes depending on your bank. You can disable or adjust this feature anytime in the app.

title: Balance not updated after bank transfer
text: When you make a bank transfer using our app, it typically takes 1 to 3 business days for the funds to appear in your account balance. Transfers initiated on weekends or holidays may take longer. To check the status, go to the Transactions tab and select the transfer in question. If more than 3 business days have passed and your balance is still not updated, please contact our support team for assistance.

title: Balance not updated after cheque or cash deposit
text: When you deposit cash or a cheque, it may take up to 3 business days for the funds to appear in your account. Cheque deposits require verification, which can cause delays. To check your deposit status, go to the app’s “Transactions” section and look for the deposit entry. If more than 3 business days have passed and the funds are still missing, please contact customer support with your deposit details for further assistance.

title: Beneficiary not allowed
text: If you receive an error stating "Beneficiary not allowed," it means the recipient’s account is currently restricted from receiving transfers. This can happen if the beneficiary’s details are incorrect, their bank is not supported, or if there are regulatory restrictions. To resolve this, verify the beneficiary’s information in your app under "Manage Beneficiaries." If details are correct, contact our support team for assistance. Transfers to allowed beneficiaries typically process instantly once the issue is resolved.

title: Cancel transfer
text: If you need to cancel a transfer, please note that transactions can only be canceled within 30 minutes of initiation. To cancel, open the app, go to "Transaction History," select the transfer, and tap "Cancel Transfer." If the transfer is older than 30 minutes or already processed, it cannot be canceled through the app. In such cases, please contact our support team immediately for assistance. Transfers typically process within 1-2 business days, so timely action is important.

title: Card about to expire
text: When your card is about to expire, we automatically send a new one to your registered address about two weeks before the expiration date at no extra cost. If you do not receive it, you can order a replacement through the app or by calling customer service—no need to visit a branch. After your card expires, activate the new card in the app to continue using it. If you need a card sooner, expedited delivery is available for a small fee.

title: Card acceptance
text: Your card is accepted at millions of locations worldwide that display the Visa or Mastercard logo, including stores, restaurants, and online merchants. However, some establishments may not accept prepaid or certain types of cards. Additionally, your card cannot be used for illegal transactions or in countries under trade restrictions. To check if a specific merchant accepts your card, look for the logo or contact the merchant directly. If you experience any issues, please contact our support team for assistance.

title: Card arrival
text: Once your new card is shipped, you will receive a tracking number via email within 2 business days. To track your card, visit the tracking link provided in the email or log in to the app and go to the “Card Delivery” section. Delivery typically takes 5-7 business days from the shipping date. If you have not received your card within 10 business days, please contact customer support for assistance.

title: Card delivery estimate
text: New debit or credit cards are typically delivered within 7 to 10 business days after your request is processed. Unfortunately, we cannot dispatch or deliver cards on a specific date. Once your card is sent, you will receive a notification with tracking details. If you need your card sooner, please contact customer support to discuss expedited options. Delivery times may vary depending on your location and postal service.

title: Card linking
text: To link or reactivate a card in the app, open the app and go to the "Cards" section. Tap "Add Card" and enter your card details or scan the card using your phone’s camera. If reactivating a previously linked card, select the card from the list and tap "Reactivate." The process usually takes a few minutes, and you will receive a confirmation notification once the card is active. If you encounter any issues, contact customer support for assistance.

title: Card not working
text: If your card is declined or not working, first check your account balance and recent transactions in the app to ensure there are sufficient funds and no suspicious activity. If everything looks normal, try restarting your phone and retrying the transaction. If the issue persists, your card may be temporarily blocked for security reasons or expired. To resolve this, contact our support team via the app or call us at 1-800-555-1234. Card issues are usually resolved within 24 hours.

title: Card payment fee charged
text: A card payment fee is charged to cover processing costs when you use your debit or credit card for certain transactions. This fee is typically a small percentage of the transaction amount, usually around 1.5%. It applies mainly to payments made at merchants who do not absorb these costs themselves. The fee will appear on your statement immediately after the transaction posts. To avoid these fees, consider using alternative payment methods like bank transfers or cash where possible. For more details, check the Fees section in your app.

title: Card payment not recognised
text: If you notice a payment in your app that you did not make, please contact our support team immediately to report the issue. To protect your account, we will temporarily block your card and investigate the transaction. You can also freeze your card instantly in the app under the “Card Settings” section. Our investigation typically takes 3-5 business days, and we will update you with the outcome. If the payment is confirmed unauthorized, you will receive a refund.

title: Card payment wrong exchange rate
text: When you make a payment in a foreign currency, our app applies the exchange rate set by the card network at the time of the transaction. This rate may differ slightly from market rates due to timing and fees. To review the exact rate used, check the transaction details in the app under “Foreign Transactions.” If you believe the rate applied is incorrect, please contact our support team within 14 days of the transaction date. We will investigate and respond within 5 business days.

title: Card swallowed
text: If your card is swallowed by an ATM, do not try to force it out. First, check if the machine displays any instructions or contact information. Then, immediately report the issue through the app’s “Report a Problem” feature or call our 24/7 customer support at 1-800-123-4567. We will block your card to prevent unauthorized use and arrange a replacement, which typically arrives within 5-7 business days. You can also visit the nearest branch for assistance.

title: Cash withdrawal charge
text: Our mobile banking app allows free cash withdrawals at ATMs within our partner network. However, withdrawals made at non-partner ATMs incur a fee of $2.50 per transaction. This charge covers the cost of using external ATM services. To avoid fees, use ATMs marked as partner locations in the app. Fees are applied immediately and will appear on your account statement within one business day. If you believe a fee was charged in error, please contact customer support.

title: Cash withdrawal not recognised
text: If you see a cash withdrawal on your account that you do not recognize, please contact our support team immediately to report the issue. To verify the transaction, check your recent activity in the app and confirm if anyone else has access to your account. If the withdrawal is unauthorized, we will investigate and may temporarily freeze your account to prevent further transactions. Typically, investigations take up to 5 business days. Meanwhile, monitor your account regularly and update your password for security.

title: Change pin
text: You can change your PIN anytime directly within the mobile banking app for your security and convenience. To change your PIN, open the app, go to Settings, select "Security," then tap "Change PIN." Enter your current PIN, followed by your new 4-digit PIN twice to confirm. The change takes effect immediately. For security reasons, PIN changes cannot be made through customer service or ATMs. Make sure to choose a unique PIN that you can remember easily.

title: Compromised card
text: If you suspect your card has been compromised, immediately lock your card in the app to prevent further unauthorized transactions. Next, contact our support team through the app or call 1-800-123-4567 to report the issue. We will investigate and, if necessary, issue a replacement card within 5-7 business days. Unauthorized charges will be refunded after verification, usually within 7-10 business days. Always monitor your account regularly and update your password for added security.

title: Contactless not working
text: If your contactless payment isn’t working, first ensure your card or device is enabled for contactless payments and has sufficient funds. Try restarting your phone or removing and re-adding your card in the app. Make sure you’re holding your card or device close to the terminal. If the problem persists, check for any app updates or contact our support team. Contactless payments usually process instantly, but technical issues may cause delays.

title: Country support
text: Our mobile banking app currently supports card issuance for residents of the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Australia, and Germany. To check if your country is supported, visit the "Supported Countries" section in the app settings. If your country is eligible, you can apply for a card directly through the app. Card delivery typically takes 7-10 business days. We are continuously expanding our services to include more countries in the future.

title: Declined card payment
text: If your card payment is declined, it may be due to insufficient funds, a daily spending limit, or a security block for unusual activity. To resolve this, check your account balance and recent transactions in the app. If everything looks correct, contact our support team through the app’s Help section. Most declines are resolved within minutes after verification. Remember to keep your card active and update your contact information to avoid interruptions.

title: Declined cash withdrawal
text: If your ATM card is declined during a cash withdrawal, it may be due to insufficient funds, daily withdrawal limits, or a temporary card block for security reasons. To resolve this, check your account balance in the app and ensure you haven’t exceeded your daily limit of $500. If your card is blocked, contact customer support through the app or call our helpline. Most issues are resolved within 24 hours, allowing you to withdraw cash again.

title: Declined transfer
text: Transfers may be declined for several reasons, including insufficient funds, incorrect recipient details, or security checks. To ensure your transfer goes through, first verify your account balance and recipient information. Then, try transferring again using the app’s transfer feature. If the issue persists, check for any alerts or restrictions on your account under Settings > Security. Transfers typically process instantly but may take up to 24 hours if additional verification is needed. Contact customer support if problems continue.

title: Direct debit payment not recognised
text: If you see a direct debit transaction you don’t recognize, you can request a trace through our app or customer service. We will contact the seller to confirm the payment details, which usually takes 5-7 business days. If the payment was unauthorized, you can dispute it by submitting a claim within 60 days of the transaction date. Once verified, we will refund the amount within 10 business days. Always review your statements regularly and report any suspicious activity promptly.

title: Disposable card limits
text: Disposable cards have a spending limit of $500 per card and can be used for up to 7 days from the date of issue. You can create up to 3 disposable cards per day through the app. To generate a disposable card, go to the Cards section, select "Create Disposable Card," and follow the prompts. These limits help protect your account from unauthorized use while providing flexible spending options. If you need higher limits, please contact customer support.

title: Edit personal details
text: To update your personal details, such as your address, open the app and go to Settings > Personal Information. Select the field you want to change, enter the new information, and save. Changes are usually updated instantly in your profile. If you need to update your address for official documents linked to your account, please upload a proof of address within the app. Our team will verify it within 1-2 business days. For assistance, contact support through the app.

title: Exchange charge
text: Currency exchanges within our app incur a standard fee of 1.5% of the exchanged amount. This fee covers processing and market fluctuations. To exchange currency, go to the "Currency Exchange" section, select the currencies, enter the amount, and confirm the transaction. The exchange is processed instantly, and the fee is displayed before you confirm. No additional hidden charges apply. For large transactions over $10,000, please contact customer support for personalized rates.

title: Exchange rate
text: Our app uses real-time market exchange rates provided by trusted financial data sources, updated every 15 minutes. When you make a currency exchange, the rate displayed on the confirmation screen is the exact rate applied to your transaction. Rates may include a small margin to cover processing costs. To see the current exchange rate, simply select the currencies in the app’s exchange feature before confirming your transaction. Rates are locked in at the moment you complete the exchange.

title: Exchange via app
text: To make a currency exchange in our app, go to the "Currency Exchange" section from the main menu. Select the currencies you want to exchange and enter the amount. Review the exchange rate and fees, then confirm the transaction. Exchanges are processed instantly during business hours (9 AM to 6 PM). Outside these hours, your request will be queued and completed the next business day. You can view your transaction history anytime in the app.

title: Extra charge on statement
text: If you see an extra charge on your statement, it may be a fee for services like overdrafts, ATM use, or monthly maintenance. To check, open the app, go to Account Activity, and tap the transaction for details. Pending charges usually clear within 3 business days. If the charge remains or you don’t recognize it, contact our support team through the app or call us at 1-800-555-1234. We’ll review the charge and help resolve any issues promptly.

title: Failed transfer
text: If your transfer is failing, first ensure you have a stable internet connection and sufficient funds in your account. Transfers may be declined if recipient details are incorrect or if the receiving bank is experiencing issues. To resolve this, double-check the account number and routing information, then try again after 15 minutes. If the problem persists after multiple attempts, contact our support team for assistance. Transfers typically process within 1-2 business days, but delays can occur due to external bank policies.

title: Fiat currency support
text: Our app supports up to five different fiat currencies per account, allowing you to hold multiple currencies simultaneously. You can add or remove currencies anytime through the Settings > Currency Management section. Currently, we support USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, and AUD for holdings and exchanges. Currency conversions are processed instantly with competitive rates. If you need assistance adding a new currency, contact support within 24 hours for help.

title: Get disposable virtual card
text: You can easily create a disposable virtual card through our mobile app for secure, one-time use. To get started, open the app, go to the "Cards" section, and select "Create Virtual Card." Choose the "Disposable" option, set your spending limit, and confirm. Your disposable virtual card will be generated instantly and ready for use. Each card is valid for a single transaction or 24 hours, whichever comes first, enhancing your online security.

title: Get physical card
text: When you receive your new physical card, your PIN is sent separately for security reasons. You can find your PIN in a sealed envelope delivered within 3-5 business days after your card arrives. If you do not receive it or lose it, you can request a new PIN through the app by going to the Card Settings section and selecting "Request PIN." The new PIN will be sent to you within 2 business days. For security, never share your PIN with anyone.

title: Getting spare card
text: You can request a spare or additional card linked to your account for added convenience. To order a second or third card, log in to the app, go to the "Cards" section, and select "Request Additional Card." There is a small fee of $10 per extra card. Once requested, your new card will be mailed within 5-7 business days. You can use all cards independently with the same account balance and settings.

title: Getting virtual card
text: To get a virtual card, open the app and go to the Cards section. Select "Request Virtual Card" and follow the prompts to verify your identity. Your virtual card will be generated instantly and available for use within the app. If you haven’t received your virtual card, ensure your app is updated and check your internet connection. If the issue persists, contact customer support. Virtual cards are available to all verified account holders and can be used immediately for online purchases.

title: Lost or stolen card
text: If your card is lost or stolen, we cannot track its location for security reasons. Please immediately lock your card in the app to prevent unauthorized use. To do this, open the app, go to the "Cards" section, select your card, and tap "Lock Card." If you believe your card is stolen, report it to our support team via the app or call us at 1-800-123-4567. We will cancel your current card and issue a replacement within 5-7 business days.

title: Lost or stolen phone
text: If your phone is lost or stolen, your card remains active and can still be used. To protect your account, immediately log in to online banking from another device or contact our support team to temporarily freeze your card and app access. You can also use our website to disable mobile app access. Once you have a new phone, download the app and verify your identity to restore access. Report lost or stolen phones as soon as possible to prevent unauthorized use.

title: Order physical card
text: To order a physical card, log in to the app and go to the "Cards" section. Select "Order New Card" and confirm your delivery address. Cards can be delivered to most locations within the country, but we do not ship to P.O. boxes or international addresses. Once ordered, your card will arrive within 7-10 business days. You will receive a notification when your card is shipped. If you need assistance, contact customer support through the app.

title: Passcode forgotten
text: If you forget your passcode, you can reset it easily within the app. On the login screen, tap "Forgot Passcode?" and follow the prompts to verify your identity using your registered email or phone number. After verification, you will be able to create a new passcode. The reset process usually takes just a few minutes. If you encounter any issues, contact our support team for assistance. Remember to choose a secure passcode that you can remember.

title: Pending card payment
text: When you make a card payment, it typically shows as pending for 1 to 3 business days while the transaction is being processed. It is normal for some payments to remain pending up to 5 business days, especially on weekends or holidays. If a payment is pending longer than 5 days, please contact our support team for assistance. Pending status means the merchant has authorized the payment, but the final settlement is not yet complete.

title: Pending cash withdrawal
text: When you withdraw cash from an ATM, the transaction may show as pending in your account for up to 24 hours while the bank processes it. If the ATM declined your card and you did not receive the money, the pending transaction will automatically be canceled and removed from your account within 48 hours. If the pending status remains after this time or you notice any discrepancies, please contact our support team for assistance.

title: Pending top up
text: When a top-up is pending, it means the transaction is still being processed. Most top-ups complete within 5 minutes, but some may take up to 2 hours due to bank processing times or network delays. If your top-up remains pending after 2 hours, please check your payment method for sufficient funds and try again. If the issue persists, contact our support team with your transaction details. Pending top-ups will either complete or automatically cancel within 24 hours, with funds returned to your original payment method.

title: Pending transfer
text: A transfer remains in pending status while it is being processed by the bank and the recipient’s institution. Typically, transfers take 1 to 3 business days to complete. If your transfer is still pending after this period, it may be due to verification checks or insufficient funds. To resolve this, please check your account balance and ensure all recipient details are correct. If the issue persists, contact our support team for assistance.

title: Pin blocked
text: If your PIN is blocked after multiple incorrect attempts, you can reset it through the app or by contacting customer support. To reset your PIN in the app, go to Settings > Security > Reset PIN, then verify your identity using your registered email or phone number. If you prefer, call our support team at 1-800-123-4567 for assistance. The reset process typically takes a few minutes, and your account will be unblocked immediately after successful verification.

title: Receiving money
text: When you receive your salary in GBP, no additional configuration is needed; the funds will appear automatically in your GBP account. You do not need to select any preferences to receive salary payments in GBP. If you wish to receive your salary in a different currency, please contact your employer to arrange this, as currency preferences depend on their payroll system. Currency conversion fees may apply if your salary is paid in a currency different from your account’s default. Payments typically appear within one business day.

title: Refund not showing up
text: If your refund is not showing up in your account, please note that refunds typically take 5 to 7 business days to process after the seller initiates them. First, confirm with the seller that the refund has been issued. Once confirmed, check your transaction history in the app under "Refunds." If more than 7 business days have passed and you still don’t see the refund, contact our support team with your transaction details. We will assist in tracking the refund with the seller.

title: Request refund
text: If you want to request a refund or cancel a payment, please note that we can only stop payments if the merchant has not yet processed the order. To check the status, go to your transaction history and select the purchase. If the item hasn’t shipped, contact the merchant directly to cancel. Refunds typically take 5-7 business days after the merchant approves the cancellation. If the payment has already been completed, you will need to follow the merchant’s return and refund policy.

title: Reverted card payment
text: If your card payment was reverted or cancelled, it may be due to insufficient funds, incorrect card details, or a security check by the bank. To resolve this, first verify your card information and available balance. If everything is correct, contact our support team through the app’s help section. Payments usually take 1-3 business days to process, but if the issue persists beyond this, we will investigate and assist you promptly.

title: Supported cards and currencies
text: You can add funds using Visa, MasterCard, and American Express cards. Supported currencies include USD, EUR, GBP, and CAD. To top up your account by card, go to the “Add Funds” section in the app, select your card type, enter the amount, and confirm the transaction. Funds usually appear in your account instantly but may take up to 10 minutes in some cases. If your card or currency is not supported, please contact customer support for assistance.

title: Terminate account
text: To terminate your account, please ensure your balance is zero and all pending transactions are complete. Then, go to Settings > Account > Close Account in the app. Follow the prompts to confirm your request. Account closure typically takes up to 3 business days. After this period, your account and personal data will be permanently deleted. If you need assistance, contact our support team via the app’s Help section.

title: Top up by bank transfer charge
text: There is no fee for topping up your account via SEPA bank transfer, and the full amount you send will be credited to your account. For SWIFT transfers, a fixed fee of €5 applies, plus any charges your sending bank may impose. SEPA transfers typically take 1-2 business days to process, while SWIFT transfers can take 3-5 business days. Please ensure you use the correct reference number to avoid delays.

title: Top up by card charge
text: We do not charge any extra fees for topping up your account using a debit or credit card, including international cards. To add funds, go to the Top Up section in the app, select your card, enter the amount, and confirm the transaction. The funds will be available instantly. Please note that your card issuer may apply their own fees, which are outside our control. If you experience any issues, contact our support team for assistance.

title: Top up by cash or cheque
text: You can top up your account by cash or cheque at any of our partner branches. To do this, visit a branch and fill out a deposit slip with your account details. For cheque deposits, please ensure the cheque is properly signed and dated. Cash deposits are credited instantly, while cheque deposits take up to 3 business days to clear. Once processed, the funds will appear in your account balance.

title: Top up failed
text: If your top-up fails, it may be due to insufficient funds, incorrect card details, or a temporary hold by your bank. To resolve this, first check your card balance and details. Try using a different payment method if available. If the issue persists, contact your card issuer to ensure there are no restrictions. Top-ups usually process instantly but can take up to 10 minutes. For urgent assistance, reach out to our support team via the app’s help section.

title: Top up limits
text: Yes, top-up limits apply to ensure security and compliance. You can top up your account up to $1,000 per day and $5,000 per month. Top-ups can be made multiple times daily, as long as you stay within these limits. If you need a higher limit, you can request an increase by contacting customer support and providing verification documents. Limit increase requests are reviewed within 3 business days.

title: Top up reverted
text: If your top-up was reverted or canceled, it may be due to insufficient funds, incorrect payment details, or a technical issue. Please check your account balance and payment information first. To resolve this, try making the top-up again through the app. If the problem persists, contact our support team with your transaction ID. Top-up reversals are usually processed within 24 hours, and any deducted amount will be refunded automatically.

title: Topping up by card
text: To add money to your card, open the app and select "Top Up," then choose your card and enter the amount. Ensure your card details are correct before confirming. If the money doesn’t appear immediately, it may take up to 5 minutes to process. If the top-up still doesn’t show in your wallet after 10 minutes, check your transaction history or contact support. Failed transactions will automatically refund within 3-5 business days.

title: Transaction charged twice
text: If you notice a transaction charged twice, please check your transaction history in the app first. Sometimes, pending charges may appear twice but only one will finalize. If both charges are completed, contact our support team within 7 days with the transaction details. We will investigate and, if confirmed as a duplicate, refund the extra charge within 5 business days. To avoid delays, provide the date, amount, and merchant name when reporting the issue.

title: Transfer fee charged
text: Our app offers free transfers between accounts within the same country. However, international transfers or currency conversions may incur a small fee, typically 1.5% of the transfer amount. To avoid fees, ensure you select domestic transfers and the same currency. If you believe a fee was charged in error, please contact our support team within 30 days with your transaction details. We will review and refund any incorrect charges within 5 business days.

title: Transfer into account
text: You can easily transfer money into your account using the bank transfer feature. To do this, log in to the app, select "Transfer," then choose "Add Money" or "Transfer to Account." Enter the amount and your bank details, then confirm the transaction. Transfers typically take 1-2 business days to process. You can also transfer money to your card via bank transfer by selecting the card as the destination account. Make sure to double-check all details to avoid delays.

title: Transfer not received by recipient
text: If your transfer has not been received within 24 hours, please first verify the recipient’s details are correct. Transfers between accounts within our bank usually process instantly, while transfers to other banks can take up to 1-2 business days. If more than 2 business days have passed, contact our support team with the transaction ID. We will investigate and resolve any issues promptly. Keep in mind weekends and holidays may delay processing times.

title: Transfer timing
text: Transfers from Europe to your account typically take 1 to 3 business days to complete. Once the funds arrive, they are available for use immediately. To ensure timely processing, please double-check that all transfer details are correct before sending. Transfers initiated on weekends or public holidays may experience delays and will be processed on the next business day. If your transfer takes longer than 5 business days, please contact our support team for assistance.

title: Unable to verify identity
text: If you are unable to verify your identity, please ensure that the information you provide matches your official documents exactly, including full name, date of birth, and address. Common reasons for verification failure include expired ID, mismatched details, or poor photo quality. To resolve this, go to the Identity Verification section in the app, re-upload clear photos of your valid ID, and double-check your details. Verification typically takes up to 24 hours. If issues persist, contact customer support for assistance.

title: Verify my identity
text: To verify your identity, please provide a valid government-issued photo ID such as a passport, driver’s license, or national ID card. Open the app, go to Settings, then select Identity Verification. Follow the prompts to upload clear photos of your ID and a selfie for facial recognition. Verification usually takes 1-2 business days. You will receive a notification once your identity is confirmed. This process helps keep your account secure and compliant with regulations.

title: Verify source of funds
text: To verify your source of funds, please provide documentation such as recent pay stubs, bank statements, or proof of sale for assets. You can upload these documents directly through the app under the "Verification" section. Our team reviews submissions within 2-3 business days. To view the origin of your available cash, go to the "Account Activity" tab, where transactions are categorized by source. If you need further assistance, contact customer support through the app.

title: Verify top up
text: To verify your top-up, open the app and go to the "Transactions" tab. Look for the recent top-up entry; a successful top-up will show as "Completed" with the amount and date. Verification ensures your funds are correctly added and prevents errors or fraud. If the status is "Pending" after 10 minutes, please contact support. Typically, top-ups process instantly but may take up to 5 minutes during high traffic. Always check your balance to confirm the update.

title: Virtual card not working
text: Virtual cards are designed for secure, one-time or limited use. Disposable virtual cards can only be used for a single transaction and will be automatically deactivated afterward. If your virtual card isn’t working, ensure you haven’t already used it or exceeded its limit. To create a new virtual card, open the app, go to the Cards section, and select “Create Virtual Card.” New cards are activated instantly and ready to use immediately. If issues persist, contact support for assistance.

title: Visa or mastercard
text: We offer both Visa and Mastercard debit cards to our customers. When you sign up for an account, you can choose your preferred card type during the application process. If you already have an account and want to switch your card, please contact customer support or visit the app’s card management section. Card delivery typically takes 7-10 business days after your request is processed. If you have any questions, our support team is here to help.

title: Why verify identity
text: To protect your security and comply with regulations, identity verification is required before full access to your account is granted. Until your identity is verified, some features like transfers and withdrawals may be limited. To verify, submit a valid ID and a selfie through the app’s verification section. Verification usually takes up to 24 hours. Once completed, you will receive a notification and full account functionality will be restored. This process helps keep your account safe and secure.

title: Wrong amount of cash received
text: If you receive less cash than requested from an ATM, please check your transaction receipt to confirm the amount dispensed. If the amount is incorrect, report the issue through the app’s “Report ATM Issue” feature within 24 hours. Provide the ATM location, time, and transaction details. Our team will investigate and, if verified, refund the missing amount within 5 business days. Keep your receipt until the issue is resolved.

title: Wrong exchange rate for cash withdrawal
text: If you notice an incorrect exchange rate or unexpected fees on your cash withdrawal abroad, please contact our support team within 7 days of the transaction. We review each case individually and may offer a refund or adjustment if an error occurred. To report, go to the app’s Help section, select “Transaction Issues,” and provide details of the withdrawal. Exchange rates are set by our banking partners and updated hourly; fees vary by location and holiday schedules. Resolution typically takes 3-5 business days.
